title: recognizing
description: Morphism: memory rows -> recognition-weighted rows. Per spotcomp/RECOGNITION.md, trust is receiver-relative and derived from PROVENANCE (the recognition-fiber, read from evidence) -- never from the {e,a,v,t} row. Tiers: sense (direct observation: prompts, tool/world results) > remembered-sense > learning (dream/inference). Learning decays with age; sense does not, so world-truths dominate over time and beat learning on conflict. HACKING: recognition-cell settlement remains a declaration obligation; this is the provenance-weight heuristic.
